description: EuroVelo is the European cycle route network coordinated by the European Cyclists' Federation. Its route planner covers more than 91,000 km of routes and lets users generate itineraries between towns in the EuroVelo database (recommended, least climbs, most developed or most direct) and download them as a single continuous GPX track, with route sections and their development status. The EuroVelo Data Hub publishes aggregated key figures and reports: the network was more than 92,500 km long in 2026, of which about 55,300 km (60 per cent) is fully developed; more than 166 million people live within 5 km of a route; a usage barometer with data from Eco-Counter reports cycling traffic change by route; and reports cover web statistics, tour operators and a cycling tourist survey. Coverage is continental (Europe). The route planner and reports are free to use and download. Caveats: there is no bulk GIS download of the whole network on the pages read, the reuse licence is not stated there, and the usage figures are indices from counter sites, not full counts. The routes and usage data support active mobility network analysis, cycle tourism demand estimates and planning of cross-border cycling infrastructure. They complement the Canadian cycling network database and are related to OpenStreetMap cycle route relations.
